text: Added LinearValueGradientSampler3 to reframe4s-resample as the canonical compiled D3 Rank 3 continuous-Double fused sampler. One eight-tap traversal computes trilinear value and exact index derivatives, followed by the complete inverse-transpose affine for world gradients. It reuses BoundaryPolicy, Validity, Sampled, and existing pointwise validity decoding. Interior knots use the right cell; the last knot uses the supported left cell; all axes require extent at least two. Tests cover anisotropic, oblique, reflected, and sheared grids, world-coordinate finite differences, exact knot policy, strided sliced/reversed Ravel views, partial constant boundaries, reject boundaries, and compile-negative categorical/rank/owner misuse. Full reframe4s-resample passes 6 of 6 on JVM and Scala.js; ownership passes at 1097 public names and 60 canonical owners.
